onboardingPage.mobilePreview: Use Tragram on the web or download the official app

slides.heading: Connect Telegram signals to MT4/MT5
slides.body: Built for traders who want to copy signals to their MT account with clear rules and full control.

slides.heading: See your accounts, channels, and trades in one place
slides.body: Track your balance, connected accounts, channels, and open orders from one screen.

slides.heading: Connect Telegram and choose the channels you follow
slides.body: Connect your authorized Telegram account, select channels and check connection status before enabling execution.

slides.heading: Connect MT4/MT5 to receive trades
slides.body: Add your server and login details securely so signals can open trades on your MT account.

slides.heading: Select the execution account
slides.body: Your access may allow several connections. New entries target the selected execution account, not all accounts simultaneously.

slides.heading: Review your current access
slides.body: Tragram currently provides Free Basic access. Paid purchases and upgrades are unavailable. Your account shows your actual features and limits.
